formatted_text: To **prohibit vehicles from turning** at an intersection.
To **prohibit traffic from turning** left or right.
To **prohibit vehicles from turning around** so that it faces the opposite direction.
To inform drivers that **overtaking vehicles is prohibited** for the **next 500m**.
To **prohibit drivers from parking** during any time of the day or night.
To **ensure traffic flow** and prevent that driver's views are not impaired by **stationary vehicles**.
To **prohibit pedestrians from proceeding past this sign** where they could cause a danger to themselves and to vehicles.
To **prohibit cyclists** from using the carriageway, lane or path where they can cause a danger to themselves and to other road users.
To **prevent cyclists and pedestrians** from using a certain road or a certain section of a road where they can cause a danger to themselves or other road users.
To **prohibit motorcycles**, on part of a carriageway, for safety reasons.
To **prohibit motorcars** from entering the area, for safety or any other reasons.
Indicates to the driver of a **taxi** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to the driver of a **minibus** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to the driver of a **midibus** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to the driver of a **bus** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to the driver of a **delivery vehicle** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to the driver of a **goods vehicle** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to the driver of a **construction vehicle** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to the driver of a vehicle **conveying dangerous goods** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to the driver of an **abnormal vehicle** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to a person **pulling a rickshaw** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to a driver of a **tour bus** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to the driver of an **agricultural vehicle** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to the driver of an **animal-drawn vehicle** that he or she **shall not proceed beyond** such sign.
Indicates to a **horse rider** that horses and riders, whether mounted on or leading a horse, are **prohibited beyond such sign**.

Indicates to the driver of a vehicle that he or she **shall not proceed beyond the sign** unless the **overall width of the vehicle** is less than the width indicated in metres by means of a number on such sign.
Indicates to the driver of a vehicle that **no vehicle which is towing another vehicle** shall proceed beyond such sign.
To **prohibit hawkers** in this area during any time of the day or night.
Indicate that the road or part of the carriageway is **reserved for buses only** and that only buses may park in the area indicated by sign **(R301-P)**.

Signs **R302 and TR302** indicate that **no other class of vehicle** may use that part of the road. Signs **R303 and TR303** indicate where the **reserved traffic lane** which **only buses may enter**, starts.
To inform you that a **parking area is reserved for bicycles only**.

Sign **(R305-P)** indicates a parking area for vehicles with a **GVM of less than 3 500 kg** where **no time limit applies but a fee must be paid**. Sign **(R306-P)** indicates a parking area that may be used **free of charge or at a fee** and the **maximum time allowed** for a vehicle to be parked is displayed.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by motorcycles only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by motor cars only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by taxis only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by minibuses only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by midi-buses only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by delivery vehicles only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by goods vehicles only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for use by **goods vehicles exceeding the indicated GVM only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by construction vehicles only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for use by **vehicles conveying hazardous substances only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by abnormal vehicles only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by rickshaws only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by tour buses only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by high occupancy vehicles only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by ambulances/emergency vehicles only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by disabled persons' vehicles only**.
To reserve a portion of a road or a parking area for **use by authorised vehicles only**.
To allow **minibuses** to take up and drop passengers off. Such a vehicle must display an **appropriate emblem, logo or any other indication** that they are minibuses.
